messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — aurum22b-int4 canary (canary-aur-22b-01) started throwing OOMs on hotstart paths when requests combine long generations + bigger batches. First seen ~2026-03-21T19:04Z on canary nodes.

Devin: Repro'd locally. Ran the local load script: `scripts/load_canary.sh --model aurum22b --batch 8 --prompt_len 64 --max_new_tokens 1024`.
Log snippet:
```
ERROR kv_alloc: cudaMalloc failed allocating 1.9GB for KV cache at token 27 -> cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
Traceback: runtime/kv_alloc.cc:142
```

Rana: Sounds like the usual KV prefetch + slot reservation interplay. On int4 variants we sometimes oversubscribe at hotstart because prefetch_window default (128) pulls too much into GPU before compaction runs.

Jamal: What are the current defaults for this canary? I thought onboarding set max_new_tokens=1024 for LLM_v2 families. That might be too aggressive for int4.

Maya: Canary config (aurum-canary-2): max_new_tokens: 1024, batch_size_limit: 8, prefetch_window: 128, slot_reserve: 0.15, slowstart: false. Traffic routed ~2% to canary pool.

Devin: Quick, low-risk experiment: lowered max_new_tokens to 256 and flipped runtime.slot_compact=true on the canary hosts. Also tried prefetch_window=64. Stress test (2000 reqs, mixed prompts) -> repro went from 7/1000 to 0/1000.

Rana: Two helpful levers: reduce default max_new_tokens for int4 variants, and enable slot_compact on hotstart code-paths. Also consider adding kv_soft_cap=0.9 so we fail fast instead of hard OOM.

Maya: Proposed rollout plan:
- set default max_new_tokens -> 256 for aurum22b-int4 canary config
- enable runtime.slot_compact=true on canary hosts (GC between requests)
- set kv_soft_cap=0.9
- monitor error_budget, p95 latency, and OOM counts for 24h

Jamal: SGTM. I'll open PR to patch the canary config and onboarding defaults (PR #3267). Suggest gating via rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 50% with health checks.

Devin: Also create a quick quality smoke eval: run the standard eval corpus with max_new_tokens=256 vs 1024 (N=200 samples) to check generation quality / QA accuracy / hallucination diffs. Int4 quantization could hide deltas when you cap length.

sre-bot: Deploy started: config patch applied to pool aurum-canary-2 (change_id=cfg-aur-179). Canary at 2% -> monitoring hooks enabled. Note: enabling slot_compact may increase transient GC latency.

Rana: Watch for GC latency spikes. If p95 latency > +200ms, back out slot_compact and try windowed compaction (compaction only when idle or between requests).

Maya: Follow-up after ~3h: initial telemetry looks good — OOM/error rate down ~92% on canary, CPU up a smidge, p95 latency +40ms. Quality smoke (Devin's run) shows negligible change (~-0.3% QA accuracy). Uploading graphs to #eng-ml-monitoring.

Devin: Nice. Next steps: persist the defaults change in onboarding docs, add a short int4 hotstart checklist (recommended max_new_tokens cap, slot_compact opt-in, kv_soft_cap), and include a quick repro snippet for load testing. I'll draft.

Jamal: Thanks folks. Leaving thread open for 24h for regressions and to confirm we can move the config to 10% if stable.
